seo.title: Security | Steps AI
seo.description: How Steps AI keeps your workspace, connected apps and customer conversations under your control.

hero.title: Your data, your customers, your control.
hero.body: Steps AI is built so you decide what the agent can read, where it can appear and when a person takes over.

items.title: You choose the content
items.body: The agent answers from the pages, files and apps you connect, and nothing else unless you switch on web search.

items.title: You choose where it appears
items.body: Set allowed domains so your website widget only runs on your own sites.

items.title: Guardrails you set
items.body: Personas can be told never to quote prices, give medical, legal or financial advice, or share internal details.

sections.title: Workspace and account protection.
paragraphs: Each workspace is separated from every other workspace, and only its members can act on it. Connection secrets for telephony and other providers are kept out of logs.
Apps connect through the provider’s own sign-in, and you can switch any connection off.

sections.title: For larger teams.
paragraphs: Enterprise plans add single sign-on with SSO and SAML, and a 99.9% uptime service level agreement.
If you end your plan, you can export your data for up to 30 days.

cta.title: Have a security question?
cta.body: Book a call and we will answer it with you.
